newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-OLAZABAL PLAYS IN ENGLISH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OLAZABAL PLAYS IN ENGLISH OPEN.

text.p: Jose Maria Olazabal of Spain will play his first tournament in Britain since the 1995 British Open when he competes in the English Open next month, the sponsors announced on Tuesday.
Olazabal, who is on a comeback after missing nearly 18 months of action with chronic foot problems, will take part in the event from May 15-18 at a new venue, Hanbury Manor, northeast of London.

The 31-year-old Spaniard, who is playing in this week's U.S. Masters at Augusta where he won three years ago, began his comeback at the Dubai Desert Classic in February where he finished joint eighth.
He was fourth at the Portuguese Open before capping his return by winning his third comeback event, the Turespana Masters.
He tied for seventh in the Freeport-McDermott Classic in New Orleans on Sunday and is 51 under par for his 16 rounds since returning to competition.

Olazabal will also play in the European zone final of the Andersen Consulting world championship on the Monday and Tuesday following the English Open, as well as the British PGA Championship at Wentworth from May 23-26.
